summary.text: Joe Campbell was first elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2020 and represents District 171, which includes Decatur and Mitchell counties and part of Grady County.

paragraphs.text: Campbell was born and raised in Camilla and earned a B.S. in agriculture from the University of Georgia.
Campbell retired in 2016 as vice president of procurement at Golden Peanut and Treenut Company after 40 years of service with the company and its predecessors.
